decisions.reason: The same-message FAQ update captures the new eligible population and automatic draw, but its secondary-sale description still says active Small Block tickets transfer to purchasers, conflicting with eligibility limited to affiliates holding referral-earned tickets.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hero copy: A dropout multimillionaire went to zero because of one oversight. Now rebuilding through an eBook model designed to free creators from Amazon's 70% cut.

Supporting headline: “My Underdog Journey: To Own Goal” — an unlimited NFT book on Base, priced at $15 forever.

Mechanics preview: Buy → own the book and receive your referral link. Refer → earn an instant $5 with no limit, plus 1 entry into a random $500 giveaway every 100 sales.

CTA text: Mint the eBook NFT for $15

Make $500 Every 100 Sales Prominent: Revise all relevant copy so the frequency is the main motivator, using language such as “constant small shots at $500.”

For the prize area: “Win $500 every 100 sales — every referral earns 1 ticket, with a fair drawing through Chainlink VRF. More referrals mean more chances!”

Also include this in the mechanics preview: “Refer to receive an instant $5 and your chance at $500 every 100 sales.”
The experience should feel like an “ongoing roulette spin” for hustlers.

Add these FAQs:
How Can a Non-Crypto Fiat Buyer Receive Commissions and Prizes?
If you're new to crypto and paying with fiat, such as a credit card, Apple Pay, etc., don't worry — the flow is intended to be straightforward. When the book is minted for $15 through Transak, a non-custodial wallet is created automatically in the background, without requiring a seed phrase initially. That wallet stores the NFT and receives all commissions and prizes. The steps are below:

At Purchase:
Transak converts the fiat into crypto and mints the NFT directly to a newly created wallet address. There is nothing for you to configure manually — the experience is seamless and non-custodial. You control the keys, without having to manage a complicated seed phrase right away.
An email confirmation will provide your mint number, which is also your referral code, along with the NFT information and a link to your dashboard at [URL_002].

Receiving Commissions ($5 per Referral):
Share your referral code, for example, “use 8421.” Whenever another person mints using it, $5 is transferred automatically to your wallet address.
To access it, sign in to the dashboard at [URL_002], either from the email link or through SIWE with the wallet created by Transak. The commissions appear immediately, with no additional action required.

Earning and Receiving Prizes:
Every referral automatically provides a ticket for the active prize drawing, tied to your NFT and wallet.
The on-chain drawings award $500 every 100 sales using fair randomness. Winners are posted on the Winners page and notified by email.
If you win, the $500 goes directly to your wallet. Look at the dashboard for the notification; we'll also email step-by-step guidance for viewing it or claiming it in fiat if necessary, such as a link to a simple exchange guide. A seed phrase is not required; use the dashboard for access.

How Can Beginners Collect Their Commissions and Prizes?
If this is new to you, don't worry — the process is automatic and simple to monitor. Here is the step-by-step flow:

Receiving Commissions ($5 per Referral):
When another person mints the book with your referral code — your mint number shown in the dashboard or confirmation email — $5 is delivered to your wallet instantly. You do not have to take any action because the smart contract manages it.

Receiving Prize Tickets:
Each completed referral additionally awards 1 ticket for the $500 prize held every 100 sales. The ticket is added to your NFT automatically and can be viewed in the dashboard.
No action is necessary; each ticket is on-chain and associated with your mint number.

Winning and Receiving Prizes:
Once a pool reaches its trigger every 100 sales, Chainlink VRF, a fair random system, runs the drawing automatically. Winners appear on the Winners page and are notified by email if they supplied one.
A winner receives $500 in their wallet immediately. Check the dashboard for alerts; we'll send an email as well.
Tickets expire once their applicable drawing is complete, while new referrals award tickets for the following blocks.

Additional Copy Adjustments:
Mechanics List: Center every item on the frequent opportunities to win $500 and the accompanying $5 commission, reinforcing the idea of “cut middlemen, funnel savings.”

Prize Section: Replace the current explanation that the pool reaches $500 every 100 sales and 1 winner is randomly chosen from all ticket holders through Chainlink VRF for provably fair randomness. The replacement should say: “**$500 every 100 sales!** 1 affiliate is chosen from that 100 sales block through Chainlink VRF for provably fair randomness. **More referrals = more chances to win!**” Make this the headline so it stands out when skimming.

General: Replace “revolutionary” with “aligned” or “fair” to reduce the hype and emphasize the ethos. Under the stats, add the tagline “Help the rebuild — share to earn.”

Visual/UI Adjustments:
Place the book cover in the hero and integrate it with the headline.
Use “Mint your eBook” / “Mint your eBook NFT.”
Live Counters: Include “Next $500 Draw In: ~X Sales” to create urgency.
Mobile Test: Confirm that the stats and mechanics stack correctly without anything being cut off.

fiat_buyer_rewards_faq.purpose: Explain how a non-crypto fiat buyer receives and accesses commissions and the recurring $500 prize.
fiat_buyer_rewards_faq.wallet_provisioning: Explain that Transak creates a seedless non-custodial wallet in the background to hold the NFT and rewards.
fiat_buyer_rewards_faq.purchase_and_access: Explain fiat conversion, automatic minting to the new wallet, and receipt of the mint number, NFT information, and dashboard link by email.
fiat_buyer_rewards_faq.commissions: Explain that each referred mint sends $5 automatically to the wallet and that commissions are visible through dashboard access by email link or SIWE.
fiat_buyer_rewards_faq.prizes: Explain that each referral awards a ticket tied to the NFT and wallet, $500 is drawn every 100 sales, winners are shown on the Winners page and emailed, and winnings go directly to the wallet.
fiat_buyer_rewards_faq.fiat_guidance: Explain that dashboard and email guidance can help a winner view the reward or convert it through an exchange without initially using a seed phrase.

beginner_rewards_faq.commissions: Explain that the smart contract automatically delivers $5 for each completed referral.
beginner_rewards_faq.tickets: Explain that each completed referral automatically adds one on-chain ticket for the $500 drawing every 100 sales and displays it in the dashboard.
beginner_rewards_faq.winner_selection: Explain that Chainlink VRF automatically selects the winner when the 100-sale trigger is reached.
beginner_rewards_faq.payout_and_notifications: Explain that the winner receives $500 immediately in the wallet and is notified through the Winners page, dashboard, and email when available.
beginner_rewards_faq.ticket_expiration: Explain that tickets expire after their applicable drawing and later referrals award tickets for following blocks.

value_updates.buyer_earnings: Explain the instant, unlimited $5 commission and one ticket per successful referral for the $500 drawing every 100 sales, while stating that any future governance-token allocation depends on FAMM succeeding and has no guarantee of success or value.
value_updates.referral_operation: Explain that each NFT mint number is its permanent referral code, each successful referred mint awards $5 plus one ticket for the recurring $500 drawing, and no-referral mints allocate the commission and ticket to a random existing NFT holder.
value_updates.prize_tickets: Explain that each completed referral awards one on-chain ticket for the applicable $500 drawing, more tickets increase the chance of winning, tickets expire after their applicable draw, and later referrals apply to following blocks.
value_updates.reward_collection: Explain that $5 commissions and $500 prize wins are delivered automatically to the user's wallet, with prize results and notifications available through the Winners page, dashboard, and email when available.
value_updates.wallet_requirement: Explain that fiat buyers need no pre-existing wallet because Transak creates a seedless non-custodial wallet automatically to hold the NFT, commissions, and prize tickets, with access through the dashboard email link or SIWE.
value_updates.secondary_sale_transfer: Explain that a purchaser receives the book, mint number as referral code, and earned badges, while expired tickets remain expired; do not describe secondary buyers as receiving active Small Block prize tickets.

decisions.reason: Its existing message-210 MODIFY already records both the affiliate-and-ticket eligibility rule and automatic Chainlink VRF execution at the 100-sale trigger.

The ticket lifecycle already limits eligibility to the current draw window, preserves ticket weighting, and records the message-210 NFT and wallet association; the source does not otherwise change ticket issuance or expiration.
Its existing message-210 copy already states that one affiliate from each 100-sales block is selected through Chainlink VRF, and no stale conflicting winner population remains.
Its existing message-210 recurring-prize copy already reflects one affiliate per 100-sales block and referral-weighted chances.
The existing message-210 MODIFY already gives the 100-sales-block affiliate selection rule and referral-ticket weighting in the landing-page prize copy.
Winner eligibility and automatic draw execution do not change the hero's layout or book-cover placement.
The countdown already uses the $500 prize and 100-sale interval introduced by the same source; winner eligibility and draw automation do not alter its displayed measure.
The change to Small Block winner selection and draw execution does not alter fiat wallet creation, custody, destination, or access methods.
Automatic execution of winner selection is distinct from payout delivery, and this Requirement already specifies automatic direct wallet transfer.
The $5 referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, and automatic payout remain unchanged by the Small Block eligibility and draw-automation decision.
Its existing message-210 MODIFY already states one entry per referral and the recurring $500 giveaway every 100 sales; no additional hero-copy state change is necessary.
